_comment: Cron-scoped settings for the REPORT-ONLY ingest agent (transcripts/ingest_cron.hardened.sh). Loaded via `claude -p --settings`. Deny overrides the global allow-list. Purpose: an unattended agent that reads untrusted transcript content must have NO web egress, NO access to secrets, and NO ability to git-push / run scripts / write to Google/Trello/Slack. It only stages files under transcripts/ and writes a manifest; all dangerous actions are done by deterministic bash after the agent exits. See COE-2026-07-13-transcript-cron-injection-exposure.md.
